purpose: Teach: 隣り/変っ/ぶらぶら/思い立っ/すかさず/たどり着く/不意/あからさま

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、お隣りに引っ越したろ?
lines.en: Hey, didn't your family just move in next door?
lines.style: Casual, light curiosity with a hint of teasing. Fast-paced, easy. Testing the ground with a half-smile in her voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、髪型変ってないか?桜
lines.style: Quick deflection, not quite meeting her energy. Soft observation masked as a question. Slight nervousness underneath the cool exterior.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、商店街をぶらぶらしてたろ?
lines.en: So I saw you hanging around the arcade the other day.
lines.style: Casual observation, not quite accusatory. Steady, matter-of-fact. Watching for his reaction with amusement in her tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、急に思い立って部活変えたな、桜
lines.en: You switched clubs pretty suddenly, didn't you?
lines.style: Matched deflection — turning it back on her. Wry, even pace. Slight tilt of irony, like he's caught her at something too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テストですかさず答え書けたな
lines.en: But you nailed that test. Answers came right out.
lines.style: Genuine acknowledgment underneath the casual tone. Slight warmth breaking through. Not over-the-top, but real respect showing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、塾にたどり着くの遅かったな、桜
lines.en: You were late getting to cram school yesterday.
lines.style: Shift toward something softer — genuine observation without judgment. Slower pace. Underlying concern masked as casual comment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、不意のテストに弱いよな
lines.en: Pop quizzes though — they always get you, don't they?
lines.style: Teasing but not mean. Dry delivery. Quick rhythm with a small laugh underneath. She knows she's poking at something real.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のヤル気、あからさまに無いだろ、桜
lines.en: Your motivation's been pretty obviously lacking lately.
lines.style: Direct observation, closer and quieter now. Concern finally breaking through the deflection. Steady eye-contact level tone — not accusatory, just honest.
